notes: Source: LiveU's official "Solo PRO Technical Specifications" brochure (PDF on LiveU's own CDN, linked from liveu.tv/products/create/liveu-solo). Important caveat: the Solo PRO ships as two distinct hardware configurations — an HDMI-input unit (912g) and an SDI-input unit (936g) — each equipped with only ONE of the two video inputs, not both simultaneously. This entry lists both inputs together since the manufacturer's own spec table groups them under a single "Video Interfaces" line; treat SDI-in and HDMI-in as mutually exclusive on any single physical unit. SDI grade set to the highest supported tier (sdi-12g) since the sheet states "12G/3G/HD/SD-SDI" as one auto-sensing input rather than per-resolution. RJ-45 Ethernet port speed is not stated in the spec sheet, so grade was omitted (not inferred). The 2x USB 2.0 Type-A ports are specifically for attaching external 4G/5G cellular modems (each port splittable to 2 modems via an optional Y-cable, per the brochure's footnote) — exact printed silkscreen labels on the chassis (e.g. "USB1"/"USB2") were not independently confirmed, so generic naming was used. The USB-C port is explicitly documented as power-input only (min. 45W USB-C PD), not a data port. No dedicated analog or digital audio connector exists — audio is embedded within the HDMI/SDI input signal. Device is a portable pack-worn/handheld encoder (112.5 x 188 x 54.5mm, ~912-936g) with no rack-mount option.
